events.description: A large crowd of civilians is densely gathered and appears to be confronting a line of police officers in riot gear; there is visible agitation, movement, and some objects being thrown (e.g., at f5–f6, debris/objects in air near the crowd), consistent with collective violent unrest or violent group clashes.

A line of police officers in riot gear (white helmets, high-visibility vests with 'POLIZEI' markings) faces a crowd in an urban street at dusk; smoke or dust is visible in the background, and the crowd appears agitated with some individuals on elevated positions (e.g., balcony/ledge). The officers maintain formation while the situation remains tense and dynamic, consistent with collective violent unrest or confrontation.
A man in a dark jacket lunges forward and appears to strike or grapple with another individual, who is bent over near the ground; physical contact is evident.
The same man in the dark jacket extends his arm toward another person in a motion consistent with punching or striking; the recipient recoils backward, indicating impact.

A line of uniformed personnel (likely police) forms a barrier facing a crowd; objects are visible on the ground, and the scene shows signs of escalation with crowd movement and tension, though no direct combat is visible in this frame alone. Supported by context of prior fighting and subsequent frames showing dispersal.

A physical altercation occurs between two individuals: a person in a white top and dark pants grabs and pushes a person in a black top and light pants, who stumbles backward; others nearby appear to intervene or react.
The same two individuals continue grappling; the person in white maintains hold on the other, with visible struggle and body contact, while surrounding people observe closely.

A person in a light-colored hooded jacket engages in physical combat with another individual wearing dark clothing; they grapple and appear to exchange blows near the center of the street, with police in yellow vests observing nearby.
After initial grappling, the hooded individual appears to push or strike a person who is bent over or falling (possibly already subdued), suggesting an attack on a vulnerable individual.

The scene transitions to a chaotic crowd with multiple individuals raising arms, gesturing aggressively, and moving erratically; some appear to be throwing objects or confronting authorities, indicating collective unrest beyond a single altercation.

A large group of people is gathered in a street at dusk/night, with multiple individuals raising arms and pointing objects (possibly phones or small devices) toward an unseen target; some appear to be recording or gesturing aggressively. In later frames (f14–f16), broken bricks or paving stones are scattered on the ground near the feet of several individuals, suggesting prior or ongoing property damage or preparation for confrontation. The crowd density, agitated postures, and presence of debris indicate collective violent unrest.

In frames f2 through f8, two individuals in the center of the crowd engage in close physical contact: one raises an arm toward the other’s head/face area while the other appears to block or recoil; their postures suggest mutual grappling or striking. This interaction is distinct from surrounding gestures and occurs amid the broader unrest.

A group of civilians confronts a line of uniformed personnel; individuals in the crowd are seen raising arms, gesturing aggressively, and throwing objects (evidenced by scattered bricks on ground in later frames). The scene shows collective unrest with active engagement between opposing groups.

Bricks and debris are scattered on the pavement (frames f5–f8), and uniformed officers in helmets and vests form a defensive line (f9–f12), indicating escalation of violent unrest. Civilians continue aggressive posturing and movement toward police (f13–f15). This constitutes sustained collective violent confrontation.
